display.purpose: Season page h1 (machine name); the home h1 uses the same voice at 820, capped at 5.25rem. Set with font-stretch: 125%.

headline.purpose: Inner page and partner panel h1. font-stretch: 122%.

subtitle.purpose: h3 and lead paragraphs (lead at 400 in steel, line-height 1.5, 60ch).

label.purpose: Nav, buttons (font-stretch 108%), spec terms, dates, captions; tabular lining figures for every number.

shadows.name: robot-floor
shadows.purpose: Under robot cut-outs on violet only (24px/0.5 on season heads, 14px on season index rows).

shadows.name: garage-light
shadows.purpose: Light pool under the chosen bay in the season line-up.

shadows.name: callout-marker
shadows.purpose: Diamond markers on the parts explorer, to read over a render.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and animation.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Button, toggle and field color changes.

motion.name: underline
motion.purpose: Nav underline and small marker changes.

motion.name: marker-scale
motion.purpose: Parts-explorer diamonds scale up when hinted or chosen.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Season card, explorer note, year panel and revealed quote fade up 10px when chosen; filtered crew members fade up 8px (320ms).

motion.name: row-lift
motion.purpose: A Seasons-index robot lifts 4px when its row is hovered.

motion.name: quote-shake
motion.purpose: A locked quote shakes before it opens (team page special quotes).

motion.name: bay
motion.purpose: Bay light, livery bar and robot dim/scale in the line-up.

motion.name: page-morph
motion.purpose: Cross-page view transition of the robot (view-transition-name per robot).

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on light grounds, e.g. the header's Partner with us.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: var(--action, #5B3FC4); color: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); border-radius: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-stretch: 108%; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--action-deep, #4A31A8); border-color: var(--action-deep, #4A31A8); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: transparent; color: var(--action, #5B3FC4); border: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); border-radius: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-stretch: 108%; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: var(--action, #5B3FC4); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Livery Button
components.description: Main action on the violet field, e.g. Partner with us in the partner strip.
components.css: .ds-btn-livery { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); border: 2px solid var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); border-radius: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-stretch: 108%; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-livery:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; } .ds-btn-livery:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle Button

components.css: .ds-toggles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-toggle { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #DCDCD8); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #1C1A26); border-color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); color: #fff; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header nav: ink links with an Action Violet underline drawn from the left on hover and current page.
components.html: SeasonsTeamOutreachPartners
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 6px; height: 2px; background: var(--action, #5B3FC4); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #5B3FC4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Garage Bay
components.description: Signature: one bay of the season line-up on violet; chosen bay gets the lavender bar, filled diamond and garage light.
components.css: .ds-bays { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; background: var(--violet, #2A2346); border-left: 1px solid rgba(196,188,223,0.22); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-bay { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 16px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgba(196,188,223,0.22); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bay::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; right: -1px; top: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bay[aria-selected="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-stage { height: 96px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(196,188,223,0.22); margin-bottom: 12px; background: radial-gradient(60% 55% at 50% 100%, rgba(185,166,242,0.26), transparent 70%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bay[aria-selected="true"] .ds-stage { opacity: 1; } .ds-no { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--on-violet-2, #C4BCDF); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dia { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-bay[aria-selected="true"] .ds-dia { background: var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); border-color: var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); } .ds-bay b { font-stretch: 125%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-bay small { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); } .ds-bay:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lavender, #B9A6F2); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Spec Sheet
components.description: Two-column definition rows under a 2px ink rule; tabular values; missing values marked tbd in steel.
components.css: .ds-spec { margin: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #1C1A26); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-spec > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7em, 2fr) 3fr; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #DCDCD8); } .ds-spec dt { color: var(--steel, #585C65); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-spec dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1C1A26); } .ds-spec dd.tbd { color: var(--steel, #585C65); font-weight: 450; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a motorsport team's season launch and partner programme. Each season's robot is launched on a deep violet field, specified with a spec sheet and dated results, and the partners who made it possible are credited at the foot of the panel and in every footer. The look comes from the team's own logo: its violet, its lavender diamond and its dark outline.

Two grounds carry the site. The violet field is for launches and partners (the home launch panel, the head of each season page, the partner panel) and for the closing calls to join or partner on the home, team and partners pages. White and paddock grey carry everything else: records, write-ups, people, forms. A near-black footer is an extra ground, used only for the footer. Sections are separated by a change of ground or by a hairline rule, never by boxes or cards. Corners are square everywhere. One type family, Archivo, does all the work: set extra wide and heavy for machine names and page titles, plain for reading.

Motion happens only in answer to the visitor: choosing a season, picking a robot part, filtering the crew, switching an outreach year, moving between pages. Nothing animates on load or on scroll, and reduced motion turns all of it off.
keyCharacteristics: Violet field for launches, partners and closing calls to join; white and paddock grey for everything else.
One family (Archivo), wide and heavy for machine names, plain for text, tabular figures for every date and spec.
Square corners on everything; rules and grounds instead of cards.
The logo's diamond is the only marker.
Robots stand on the violet as cut-outs at one scale, with a soft floor shadow.
Motion only in answer to the visitor.

rules.name: The Livery Stripe Rule
rules.body: Lavender lives on dark grounds only (violet or footer); text selection and the tap highlight are the only exceptions. On white, the accent is Action Violet. Never put lavender text or rules on paper.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Violet is for launching machines, crediting partners and the closing call to join or partner. Write-ups, people, records and forms sit on paper or paddock grey.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every date, spec and number uses tabular lining figures (<time> and .num get them automatically; spec, facts and figures values set them).

rules.name: The Width Is The Voice Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from the width axis plus weight, not from a second family, all-caps tracking or color. Wide is for names and titles, with a lighter 108–112% on buttons, tabs and the phone menu; reading text stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Flat Paddock Rule
rules.body: No shadows on buttons, cards, menus or panels. Shadow belongs to robots on the floor and to markers on a render, nothing else.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: The diamond is the only marker. No circles, checkmarks, arrows or icon glyphs as bullets or badges; the only SVG icon is the Menu button's.

dos: Do change colors, sizes and spacing in :root in css/style.css, never in a component rule.
Do use the violet field only for launching a machine, crediting partners or a closing call to join or partner; put everything else on paper or paddock grey.
Do use Action Violet (#5B3FC4) for links and buttons on light, and Lavender (#B9A6F2) only on violet or the footer.
Do set machine names and page titles wide (118–125%) and heavy (780–840); keep reading text at normal width.
Do give every date, spec and number tabular figures.
Do separate content with a 2px ink rule over a list and 1px hairlines between rows.
Do set --w to the image's pixel width on every .photo so photos are never upscaled.
Do keep the sponsor strip in every footer, built from SPONSORS / SUPPORTERS in js/main.js.
Do add new raster images only as the team's own photos or CAD renders, and record how any edited one was made.
Do make motion an answer to a click, tap or key, with the shared easing, and let reduced motion turn it off.
donts: Don't add a second font family or system display faces.
Don't add shadows to buttons, panels or menus; shadow is only for robots on the floor and explorer markers.
Don't use any marker other than the diamond: no icon glyphs, emoji, checkmarks or arrows as bullets.
Don't number the season tabs (01/02/03) or put small labels (eyebrows) above headings.
Don't animate on page load or on scroll, and don't add counters that tick up.
Don't put content in boxed cards with borders and shadows; use rows and grounds.
Don't generate or invent images, results, sponsors or numbers; leave a tbd instead.
Don't show a photo larger than its own pixels.
